changes.to: Yobotics announced Y20-W on 18 September 2025 and lists it in the quadruped catalogue, but its parameter table is published only as a graphic on the maker's site; no text specification, datasheet or PDF was found, so no field is filled from the maker and the record stays unconfirmed. Third-party transcriptions of that graphic (e.g. 920 x 550 x 670 mm, 52 kg, IP67, 40 kg dynamic load) are not maker sources and were not used.
Wheel-legged version of the Yobotics Y20 announced on 18 September 2025 for all-terrain inspection work.
